# Guit-Oid

> Free AI-powered identification tool for guitars, amps, pedals, and pickups — "if it's got strings and a story." Upload a photo and Guit-Oid identifies it, or roasts it. Ask Fretboard Fred anything about setup, repair, spotting a fake, or what that attic find is actually worth. Part of the FeelFamous -Oid Ecosystem.

Live at: https://guitar-oid.netlify.app

## Core tool (free, no sign-in required)

- Identify mode: photo in, make/model/era/value out.
- Roast My Guitar mode: same upload flow, honest opinions from Fretboard Fred instead of a formal verdict.
- Ask Fred — a chatbot voiced as a 58-year-old guitar tech who's been setting up and repairing guitars since he was 14, ran a repair shop in Camden, now fixes guitars from his garage. Free-form workshop-voice chat about setup, repair, spotting a fake, or what an attic find is worth.

The identification tool, roast mode, and Ask Fred are all free forever, with no sign-in wall and no paid tier required.

## Membership (Patreon — optional, supports hosting, does not gate the tool)

- Villager — £4.95/month
- Elder — earned, not bought
- Founder — £14.95/month

Membership funds a hosted hut/hamlet page, kudos, leaderboard and activity feed — none of it is required to use the identification tool or Ask Fred.
